name: Guntersblum (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and blue, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Guntersblum (a white eagle above red figures on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Guntersblum; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Guntersblum arms — eagle and figures on blue
